# Key Vault Logs

Key Vault audit events covering secret/key/certificate access, authentication failures, throttled operations, and vault availability.

content.query:
// Key Vault operations over time by result status
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| summarize
    Success = countif(ResultSignature == 'OK' or httpStatusCode_d >= 200 and httpStatusCode_d < 300),
    Failures = countif(httpStatusCode_d >= 400)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Vault Operations Over Time (Success vs Failures)
Top Key Vault Operations

content.query:
// Unauthorized access attempts (403 / 401)
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| where httpStatusCode_d == 403 or httpStatusCode_d == 401
| summarize FailureCount = count() by Resource, OperationName, CallerIPAddress, identity_claim_upn_s
| top 25 by FailureCount desc
| project Vault = Resource, Operation = OperationName, CallerIP = CallerIPAddress, UPN = identity_claim_upn_s, FailureCount
content.title: Unauthorized Access Attempts (401 / 403)

content.query:
// Secret and key access by caller identity
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| where OperationName in ('SecretGet', 'SecretList', 'KeySign', 'KeyDecrypt', 'KeyEncrypt', 'CertificateGet')
| summarize AccessCount = count() by OperationName, identity_claim_upn_s, CallerIPAddress, Resource
| top 25 by AccessCount desc
| project Vault = Resource, Operation = OperationName, Identity = identity_claim_upn_s, CallerIP = CallerIPAddress, AccessCount
content.title: Secret / Key / Certificate Access by Identity

content.query:
// Throttled requests (HTTP 429) over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| where httpStatusCode_d == 429
| summarize ThrottledCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Throttled Requests (429) Over Time

content.query:
// Vault operation latency percentiles
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| where isnotempty(DurationMs)
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Vault Operation Latency (P50 / P95 / P99)

content.query:
// Recent vault management operations (create, delete, update, purge)
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
| where OperationName has_any ('SecretSet', 'SecretDelete', 'KeyCreate', 'KeyDelete', 'CertificateImport', 'CertificateDelete', 'SecretPurge', 'KeyPurge')
| project TimeGenerated, Vault = Resource, Operation = OperationName, Identity = identity_claim_upn_s, CallerIP = CallerIPAddress, Status = ResultSignature
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent Vault Management Events (Create / Delete / Purge)
